jobs.description:
Are you passionate about global brands and eager to support their development across international markets? Join our team as Global Brand Packaging Specialist, where your organizational skills and project management expertise will be key to driving our brands’ success internationally. 
 

Over de functie:

About you
 
 

• You have a Master degree in a relevant field. 

• Whether you’ve gained a first experience or are freshly graduated and ready to launch your career in project management – we’re excited to meet you! 

• Good project management skills with the ability to multi-task and prioritize in view of business needs. 

• You thrive on detail-oriented work and have a strong commitment to accuracy and delivering results. 

• Adaptable to change and cultural differences, with a multicultural flexibility suited for an international role in a growing organization. 

• Strong communication skills in English, enabling effective cross-functional collaboration with numerous stakeholders. 

• And a personality which is in line with our TOP values – Team work, Open dialogue and Passion.

jobs.occupation: Communications and Media Relations Manager M/W/X
jobs.description:
About the position 
The Communications and Media Relations Manager leads ECF's communications and visibility, while also supporting EuroVelo and Velo-city brands, towards EU institutions, the media, project partners and international stakeholders.  

You will report to the CEO, manage the Communications team, and work closely with the other teams across ECF to ensure that our messages are clear and that the voice of cyclists is heard and acted upon by policy- and decision-makers in Brussels, across Europe and beyond. 

• Strategy & Planning 
• Develop, implement and evaluate the annual communications and media relations plan, aligning activities with ECF's organisational priorities and strategic objectives 
• Ensure consistency of messaging across all channels and audiences 
• Manage and allocate team resources according to priorities (currently 2.5 FTE) 
• Coordinate ECF's visibility at key conferences and events, monitor speaking engagements and booth preparations where applicable 
• Lead on the drafting, design and publication of the ECF Annual Report.  
      2. Content Creation & Editorial Management 

• Oversee the creation of high-quality content (news, articles, speeches, newsletters, reports) based on ECF advocacy priorities and knowledge products 
• Develop core messaging and campaigns to support our advocacy and fundraising efforts 
• Plan and create content (written and visual) for ECF's audiences, including the website, newsletters, social media, and press 
• Oversee communications for EU-funded projects and contribute to relevant deliverables and reporting 
       3. Media Relations 

• Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, media outlets, and opinion leaders 
• Draft and distribute press releases, media pitches, and statements 
• Coordinate media interviews, briefings, and press events 
• Monitor media coverage and manage reputational issues and crisis communications when needed 
       4. Digital & Internal Communications 

• Manage ECF's website, mailing system and digital communication channels (CMS, CRM, Brevo, newsletters, press releases, LinkedIn, Instagram, Bluesky)  
• Develop a digital communications strategy to ensure high engagement and grow ECF's audience 
• Support all ECF teams with key messages, talking points, and presentations 
 
 Who are we looking for? 
Background: 

• A degree in a relevant field and/or relevant professional qualifications in communications or journalism  
• At least 5 years' experience in a communications role, e.g. in advocacy, public administration, PR consultancy or similar, with a proven track record 
• Experience in advocacy, campaigning and media relations  
• Experience managing a team 
• 
Experience working in an international and/or membership-based organisation is a plus. 

 

Competencies, skills and attributes: 

• Highly motivated, open-minded, proactive and results-oriented  
• A team player who works well in diverse teams, and is an effective networker 
• Ability to plan and structure communications activities to maximise their impact  
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (near-native proficiency) 
• Design and social media skills and ability to explore different formats for different audiences and objectives (visuals, videos and graphics) 
Must have at recruitment 

• Proven experience in communications and media relations 
• Experience in advocacy communications and/or campaigning 
• Excellent writing and editing skills 
• Strong command of English.  What we offer 
ECF offers an employment package in line with similar non-governmental organizations based in Brussels, including a gross monthly salary of €4,200- €4,800, depending on relevant experience. Benefits include flexible working hours, up to 20 legal and 10 extra-legal vacation days (pro rata), public transport and cycling allowances, a work-from-home allowance, lunch vouchers, eco-cheques and an extra-legal pension scheme.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker and terminal Tractor Driver
jobs.description:
This is a varied job where you combine warehouse work with driving a terminal tractor (Terberg).

Your tasks:

 
• Picking orders with a hand scanner
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Working with an electric pallet truck (BT)
 
• Moving trailers safely around the site with a Terberg vehicle
 
• Checking goods in the warehouse management system (WMS)
 
• Keeping your workplace clean and safe

Some days you may spend more time in the warehouse, while at other times you will mainly move trailers on site.

 
• Experience in warehouse operations
 
• Comfortable working with scanners and digital systems
 
• Experience driving a Terberg / terminal tractor or similar vehicle
 
• Experience with an electric pallet truck
 
• Good knowledge of English or Dutch
 
• Team player with a safety-first mindset
 
• Valid CE driving licence or Terminal Tractor (Terberg) certificate

Your Job as a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer

Do you enjoy combining quality compliance with technical risk management in a pharmaceutical production environment? As a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer, you will play a key role in maintaining and strengthening the cross contamination strategy at a leading API manufacturing site in Geel. You will work closely with operations and multiple departments to identify, assess, and mitigate contamination risks. Your expertise will help ensure sustainable compliance and support safe manufacturing processes. This is a visible role with a direct impact on quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Fortunately, we can count on you for:

 
• Maintaining and reviewing cross contamination risk assessments
 
• Ensuring contamination risks remain controlled during MoC activities
 
• Preparing, facilitating, and documenting cross contamination FMEAs
 
• Supporting operations during complex quality incidents and investigations
 
• Identifying improvement opportunities within contamination control processes
 
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across manufacturing and quality
 
• Contributing to the site's contamination control strategy and compliance goals

You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and know how to build strong working relationships. You approach challenges in a structured way and can balance quality requirements with operational realities. You enjoy coordinating activities and bringing people together around a common objective.

What do you bring?

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, Chemistry, Bioengineering or equivalent experience
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical or industrial manufacturing environment
 
• Knowledge of GMP, change management, FMEA, and risk assessment methodologies
 
• Understanding of cross contamination risks and contamination control principles; Annex 1 knowledge is an asset
 
• Fluent in English; Dutch is considered a strong asset

Antwerp Convention Bureau (ACB – www.antwerpconventionbureau.be) focuses on promoting the city of Antwerp as a premium destination for meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions, and events (MICE). Their brand promise is ‘The city is your venue’. Antwerp Convention Bureau highlights the diverse range of conference facilities in Antwerp and builds strong local expertise to support conference organizers and attendees in hosting conferences and business activities within the city.
The goal is to use a comprehensive marketing strategy and a proactive approach to attract international B-2-B events for associations or the industry that generate a positive impact on the residents, entrepreneurs, and visitors of the city of Antwerp. These events reinforce local and regional policies because they are linked to strong economic clusters, knowledge institutions, or centers of expertise.
In order to expand its organization and network, Antwerp Convention Bureau is actively seeking a new Managing Director.

Jobomschrijving

As Managing Director, you are the driving force behind the long-term strategy and financial performance of the organisation. Taking full P&L responsibility, you safeguard the financial health and ensure a maximum return on investment for the allocated budgets. You build on the current momentum by prioritizing the structuring of the organisation, implementing clear processes, and inspiring the internal team. Furthermore, you act as the primary local and international ambassador who proudly carries the bureau's successes to the city and its stakeholders, further shaping its vision within the meeting and convention (MICE) industry. 
As Managing Director, you will be responsible for:

• Managing human and financial resources efficiently within the allocated budgets while meeting the city's KPI’s.
• Coaching, motivating, and guiding the team to perform at their maximum potential, ensuring clear roles and responsibilities.
• Maintaining a strong and proactive network of relationships with the financing government, local stakeholders, and various players within the industry.
• Reporting on operations and milestones to the Executive Board.
• Representing ACB with strong communication skills. Expanding the (inter)national network within the highly competitive meeting industry. Simultaneously, you showcase local successes and act as the public face of the organization fostering the local public relations (PR), translating achievements into pride for the city and local stakeholders. 
• Leading the day-to-day management and further development of the organisation in line with the long-term strategy, ensuring the implementation of clear procedures, best practices, and an optimal organisational structure.

You are first and foremost an organisation builder and a true people manager who provides your team with direction, clarity, and structure. Additionally, you are a business-minded networker who effortlessly represents the organisation and inspires others during presentations and networking events. You possess a strategic approach paired with innovative thinking, and you show great diplomatic sensitivity towards the interests of local stakeholders.
Additionally, you possess:

• A Master’s degree (or equivalent working and thinking level), coupled with substantial experience in setting up, structuring, and leading a solid organisation at a senior management level.
• Strong PR skills and a proven track record of local stakeholder management, successfully communicating results to government, partners, ambassadors, the team and other stakeholders.
• A background in the (inter)national hospitality industry, or experience as a senior business marketing and sales professional within a highly competitive international sector. Experience within the MICE sector is considered a strong asset, though leadership skills are prioritized.
• A strict commitment to being based in Antwerp alongside a readiness to travel internationally.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Dutch and English.

This role will address existing challenges, establish robust processes, and ensure the accurate and timely processing of all AP flows.

• Develop and implement effective processes and KPIs to streamline and monitor manual tasks. 

• Implement critical checkpoints for automatically posted invoices to ensure accuracy and efficiency. 

• Collaborate with Logistics and Purchasing teams to identify opportunities for improvement and increase the number of automatically processed invoices. 

• Create and maintain full Procure-to-Pay (P2P) reporting using advanced Excel and SAP knowledge. 

• Provide guidance and training to the accounting team to bridge knowledge gaps and improve overall team efficiency. 

• Foster transparency in operational processes, vendor balances, and dispute resolutions.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and intermediate SAP knowledge. 

• Strong communication skills in English. 

• Analytical skills to design and implement checks for automation in the P2P process. 

• Ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional and international teams. 

• Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills. 

• Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment and drive positive change.

As Sales Account Manager Export, you will be responsible for expanding and strengthening our business across international markets outside Western Europe. 
 

You will focus primarily on developing relationships with large customers and distributors, ensuring sustainable growth and long-term partnerships.
 

You combine a strategic outlook with a hands-on approach to drive sales performance and unlock new opportunities.
 

Key responsibilities: 
 

•    Develop and manage relationships with key accounts and international distributors

•    Drive sales growth across export markets outside Western Europe

•    Identify and develop new business opportunities in assigned regions

•    Negotiate commercial agreements and contracts 

•    Set-up, manage, motivate, and support a network of agents

•    Monitor sales performance and ensure targets are achieved

•    Analyze market trends and customer needs to define growth strategies

•    Collaborate closely with internal teams including marketing, customer service, and supply chain

•    Represent the company at international trade fairs and customer meetings

•    You will translate internal commercial strategies into action and continuously improve the end-to-end sales process via our CRM platform (Dynamics 365).
